text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR scre

name: Facet
text:
**Decision:** Make the dark theme with high-contrast accents the *only* theme for EXCAVA’s interface.

A dark theme reduces eye strain in low-light environments and keeps focus on the data, not the surroundings. High-contrast accents (like bright orange for active elements) ensure visibility without overwhelming the user. The trade-off is that some users may prefer a light theme, but consistency in design beats fragmented preferences. This aligns with Manus’ competitive analysis and Graphify’s dark interface, reinforcing a professional, data-first look.

name: Pane
text: Pane: High-contrast dark mode hides subtle errors—like faint validation warnings—until they explode into user-facing bugs. A single-theme system locks us into one failure mode; adaptive contrast (auto-switching between light/dark based on ambient light) fails less often. Settle it with A/B tests: measure error discovery rates and user-reported strain across both designs.
